Parliamentary panel: Only 3 Kashmiri migrant families returned permanently to Valley

A parliamentary panel has reported that only 3 out of 6,500 Kashmiri migrant families have permanently returned to the Kashmir Valley. The panel's findings highlight a low rate of permanent return for Kashmiri migrants. The specific number of families and the low return rate are the key details presented.
